digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify gate and External Integration workflow
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay in Gerrit Verify contributed a measured 184.32-second macOS lower bound per-change and must be moved out of the hot path while preserving all behavioral and contractual assertions.

Committed deterministic Pandoc output artifacts must be generated and validated to cover all 1,383 ordered real-Pandoc conversions from 178 corpus bodies across three strata, with a fail-closed static converter replacing subprocess replay in Verify.

One representative live product-path body from each stratum (code_arrow, table, prose) plus compact version/platform/argv/stdin/timeout probes must remain in Gerrit Verify to retain real-Pandoc coverage for safety-critical paths.
A new dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay job with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix must run complete corpus replay against real Pandoc on a weekly schedule and workflow_dispatch trigger.
Fixture regeneration, non-writing validation, and platform-binary fingerprint mismatch detection must be explicit and deterministic to prevent stale committed outputs.
